title: Equity Disbursement Schedule — Trade-In Agreements
content:
Positive trade equity under **Trade-In Agreements** is applied to a linked purchase order or paid to the customer on the grade terms below, which also state what happens to a traded vehicle when the purchase is returned.

| Term | Inoperable | Rough | Fair | Good | Very Good | Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Positive equity applied to the linked purchase order within (business days after the payoff is sent, or after pickup when there is no lien) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Equity owed to the customer paid out within (business days after the equity becomes payable) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Payout channels | ACH to the customer, check to the customer | ACH to the customer, check to the customer | ACH to the customer, check to the customer | ACH to the customer, check to the customer | ACH to the customer, check to the customer | ACH to the customer, check to the customer |
| Payout held until a transferable title or lien release is in hand | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel keeps the traded vehicle when the linked purchase is returned under the 7-day return (equity refunded as cash) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

- **Application to a purchase.** At every grade positive equity reaches the linked purchase order within 1 business day after the payoff is sent, or after pickup where the vehicle had no lien.
- **Payout.** Equity owed to the customer is paid within 3 business days after it becomes payable, by ACH or by check to the customer, and only once a transferable title or lien release is held.
- **Returned purchase.** When the linked purchase goes back under the 7-day return, Kestrel keeps the traded vehicle and the equity is refunded to the customer as cash.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A liened trade whose payoff was sent on a Tuesday and whose purchase order is still contracted has its positive equity applied to that order by the end of Wednesday, 1 business day later.
